name: Wild Heart

features.name: 10-spin wild cycle
features.description: Wilds mark cells and reappear there.

features.name: Sticky starts
features.description: Free spins begin with 0, 4 or 9 sticky wilds.

review:
A sneaky raccoon's trip through Mexico on 5x4 and 20 lines. In the base game a 10-spin cycle runs: wilds mark the cells they land on, then come back to those cells later in the cycle.

Three scatters give 10 free spins starting with 0, 4 or 9 sticky wilds. Very high volatility, 2,820x max and 96.92% RTP, with free spins about once every 166 spins. Same cycle idea as Mice & Magic Wonder Spin, with a better RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
